FN-VKHIVPP-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 302
Committee: Agriculture and Forestry Sponsor: Representative Jamie Kiel
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/19/2024
House Bill 302 as introduced would propose an amendment to the Constitution of Alabama
2022 that, if ratified could increase receipts to the Franklin County Board of Education General
Fund by an undetermined amount dependent on any proceeds received from the sale of natural
resources, or lease or sale of, certain 16th Section and indemnity land owned by the board and
located in Walker County and Fayette County.
This bill would increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the State General
Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2025.
Page 1
